about_the_game:
Hello! We are the development team of [Trilogy of the Moon].

We're excited to share some wonderful news from the [Trilogy of the Moon] team.

We've prepared a free demo version for all of you who have been waiting!

💫 Demo Version Contents

- In the demo version, you can enjoy selected content and story

(You can play portions of the full version, which consists of a main chapter and 12 ending chapters.)

- Profile and progress rewards are not available.

Your valuable interest and feedback mean a great deal to us.

We appreciate your continued support and encouragement 🙏

🌙 About the Game

The story begins with Ha Dong-hun, South Korea's finest photographer.

Behind his glamorous exterior lies a secret he can't tell anyone,

Until one day, a mysterious package arrives. Then, something unbelievable happens.

Three royal consorts from the ancient Baran Kingdom, from a thousand years ago, appear in the modern world!

As the protagonist, who is the reincarnation of King Hadou IV of Baran,

You'll begin an extraordinary cohabitation with three charming consorts, played by fashion models.

Can you unlock the mysteries of your past life and find true love?

🌙 Character Introduction

Suk-won: A brilliant beauty who quickly adapts to modern life

Hae-in: A woman of mystery with hidden charms

Seung-a: A noble soul with elegant grace

Add Trilogy of the Moon, a romance that transcends time, to your wishlist!

A special story awaits, shaped by your choices.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains sensitive contents such as partial nudity or sexual content, as well as alcohol use, may not be suitable for all age ranges.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
